artists.biography:
Matthew Charles "Matt" Berry (born 2 May 1974) is an English actor, writer, comedian and musician. Berry is perhaps best known for his appearances in The IT Crowd, Garth Marenghi's Darkplace, The Mighty Boosh, and Snuff Box. He is renowned for his deep voice; he has voiced several advertisements, most notably for Volvic, The Natural Confectionery Company, Absolute Radio, and MoneySupermarket.

As a musician, Berry composed all the music for Snuff Box, as well as the music for AD/BC: A Rock Opera, which he co-wrote with Richard Ayoade. AD/BC was a half-hour parody of overblown musicals in general and Jesus Christ Superstar in particular, telling the story of the innkeeper who allowed Mary, Joseph, and the baby Jesus to sleep in his manger. AD/BC was broadcast in December 2004 and featured Fulcher and Mighty Boosh stars Julian Barratt and Noel Fielding. He also performed a song for an episode of Garth Marenghi's Darkplace entitled "One Track Lover", a spoof of cheesy romantic 80s songs.

perplexity.description:
Simplicity, released on November 17, 2023, is Matt Berry’s tenth studio album and his first major collaboration with the legendary library music imprint KPM Music, in addition to his ongoing partnership with Acid Jazz Records. The album is a distinctive blend of electronic, jazz, and rock elements, drawing inspiration from the classic British library music of the 1960s and 1970s. Berry’s compositions on Simplicity are characterized by lush arrangements, vintage synthesizers, and a cinematic quality, reflecting both his deep appreciation for retro soundtracks and his own evolving musical identity.

Within Berry’s discography, Simplicity stands out as a deliberate homage to the instrumental library records that shaped the sound of British television and film. The album continues his exploration of mood and atmosphere, following the more introspective and jazz-inflected works like The Small Hours and Phantom Birds. Critics have noted its authenticity and craftsmanship, praising Berry’s ability to channel the spirit of classic KPM while adding his own contemporary flair. The album was well-received for its nostalgic yet fresh approach, cementing Berry’s reputation as a versatile and inventive composer in both soundtrack and studio album contexts.
